Asha (CS): FYI FableMetrics just flagged they want to expand to two more product teams (Search + Recs). They mentioned session-based embeddings and more realtime calls. Asking for a quick ops checklist and any blockers.
Luca (AM): Nice — saw the note in the renewal review. Do we know expected qps/qph from each team? helps size Dedicated vs burst.
Asha (CS): They gave an internal estimate: Search ~600 rps at peak, Recs ~250 rps, plus batch embed jobs overnight. They also want lower latency tail.
Kai (Eng): 600 rps is non-trivial. If that's sustained we should recommend a Dedicated pilot w/ autoscale and KV cache enabled. Rough sizing: ```search peak: 600 rps
recs peak: 250 rps
batch embeds: 200k docs nightly```
Ravi (Solutions): Agreed. Also need to capture model choices — they want to try a larger open model for quality, but quantized variants for cost. We'll propose two routes: 1) Dedicated GPU pool + canary routing, 2) Hosted with burst & cache tuning while they evaluate.
Asha (CS): I'll set up an enablement session next week for their infra and SREs. Can someone draft a one-pager with recommended config and estimated month-1 cost delta? @Luca you own pricing side.
Luca (AM): On it. I'll run numbers and include a few promotion/renewal angles — if we lock Dedicated for 6 months they get committed pricing and priority capacity.
Kai (Eng): I'll dump a config snippet we can share. It's rough but actionable: 
```yaml
model: rdx-4-quant
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
autoscale: min_replicas:2, max_replicas:10
route_policy: latency-priority for search
```
Asha (CS): perfect. Also they asked for a short playbook for onboarding new teams (steps + contacts). Can we include: enablement call, SDK keys + env, sample traffic generator, canary checklist, SLO targets?
Ravi (Solutions): I'll author the playbook. Will include a simple traffic generator script and a sample eval set for regression checks.
deploy-bot: task created — "fablemetrics-dedicated-proposal" assigned to @Luca @Kai @Ravi, due in 3 business days.
Luca (AM): Quick ask — any red flags on renewal? their current usage is moderate but expansion looks like upsell, not churn. We should still track quota escalations and any errors during canary.
Asha (CS): No churn signal yet. Risk low. Primary challenge is ramp complexity and cost sensitivity. We'll capture feedback during enablement and feed to Product/Optimize team if they hit latency/cost regressions.
Kai (Eng): one more technical note: advise prefix caching for Search queries to reduce compute; recommend warmup for KV cache before cutover. I'll add a short runbook snippet.
Asha (CS): Great. I'll DM their SRE to schedule the session and share the one-pager when ready. Thanks team :handshake:
Luca (AM): Thx — will post pricing draft in this thread when ready.
Ravi (Solutions): Draft playbook ETA 48hrs.
Asha (CS): Closing loop — capture any immediate asks here. If no blockers we'll convert to sales ops for a Dedicated proposal after the enablement call.
